title: Northgate Business Membership Tenure Terms: Route Fee Credit Against the Business Restocking Charge
content:
Business membership benefit terms for the business restocking charge on a changed-mind return of special-order merchandise bought through Northgate Purchases & Returns. The credit turns on the presenting membership's tier and on how long ago it was opened, as the Northgate Memberships record shows.

## Route fee credit against the business restocking charge

When the membership is a Northgate Business Plus Membership opened 60 months or more before today, the route pickup fee entered for that same authorization is credited in full; when it is a Northgate Business Plus Membership opened less than 60 months before today, or a Northgate Business Membership opened 60 months or more before today, half of that route pickup fee is credited; otherwise none of it is credited.

- **The route pickup fee entered for that same authorization** is the amount of the return pickup fee entry booked on the purchase against the sale line of the return authorization being confirmed.
- **The membership** is the one presented on the purchase; its tier and opened date are those on its Northgate Memberships record.
- **Application:** the credited part (1, 0.5 or none of the route pickup fee) is subtracted from the business restocking charge after that charge has been rounded half up to the cent; a result below zero is taken as zero, and the business restocking charge is rounded half up to the cent.

| Presenting membership | Opened | Share of the route pickup fee credited |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | 60 months or more before today | 1 (in full) |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | less than 60 months before today | 0.5 (half) |
| Northgate Business Membership | 60 months or more before today | 0.5 (half) |
| Northgate Business Membership | less than 60 months before today | none |

## Worked credits (hypothetical figures)

| Charge before credit | Route pickup fee entered | Share credited | Charge after credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 126.72 | 109.00 | 1 | 17.72 |
| 126.72 | 109.00 | 0.5 | 72.22 |
| 80.00 | 189.00 | 1 | 0.00 (below zero taken as zero) |
| 126.72 | 109.00 | none | 126.72 |
